title: Qualify first-class native, Cognee and Hillock memory backends
body:
The selected native, Cognee or Hillock owner now retains literal conversation episodes and source-bound purpose, decisions, feedback, questions and finite preferences. The four follow-up gaps are qualified: real-model Cognee CHUNKS retrieval uses bounded parallel indexing without synchronous graph extraction; conversation-v2 budgets the complete deployed tokenizer/template; canonical source revalidation covers derived controls and guarded delivery; the new path passes authenticated existing-channel delivery with every owner.

Validation:
- Real pinned Cognee 1.6.2 with deployed Bekko embeddings passes cold 100/1,000/10,000-record recall inside 30 seconds: 21.1/22.1/22.5 seconds, with zero identity errors.
- Native/Cognee/Hillock each pass eight conversation trajectory checks and seven real Gemma4 E2B answer checks with exact token receipts, including deletion, project privacy, expiry, topic return and corrections.
- Four deployed gateway probes match counted/reported prompt tokens exactly, including multilingual text, roles, literal special delimiters and whole-turn history omission.
- Live existing-channel qualification replays authenticated human/bot history, runs the deployed bridge reply path and actual gateway, verifies 990-token receipts for all three owners, guards actual Discord sends and retains real response IDs. The private test thread is archived and locked; this is historical-source replay and bot-authored fixture delivery.
- 121 Discord tests, memory/Cognee/egress race tests, PostgreSQL source-only admission and final runtime-role replay, module ownership/export checks, secret scans and pinned provider contracts pass.

The gateway preservation mode is explicit and buffered; ordinary requests keep their current behavior. Conversation-v2 is enabled on the existing production bridge with native still selected. Existing identity, workflows, personas, volumes and model weights are retained. Broader semantic-quality research and protected main/release promotion remain separate from this testing-branch PR.

Evidence and measured limits: docs/validation/memory-backend-completion-2026-10-11/README.md and evidence/final-v2/. The branch also includes exact-revision Hillock prerelease discovery/qualification; pinned and discovered upstream revisions have separately retained contract and scale results.
